reviewItem.question: Is fact vf-fb79bb6ccebd (Bucket v1 schema: 1 field now required: `status.artifact.digest`) still correct? Reject to retract it; correct to supersede it.

consequence.statement: Bucket objects using the source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1 schema that omit status.artifact.digest are rejected.
